prompt: Bug report: the DAAL objective function optimization_solver::cross_entropy_loss (multinomial logistic loss, CPU) returns different values and gradients for the same X, y and beta when it runs on 4 or more threads. With 1 or 2 threads, repeated calls are bit-identical and match a NumPy reference (-log_softmax(X @ W.T + b)[range(n), y].mean() and its gradient). Example: 200000 rows, 100 features, 7 classes, interceptFlag=true, resultsToCompute=value|gradient, beta = 0.1*N(0,1). Calling compute() 20 times with 1 thread gives identical results; with 4, 8 or 14 threads the value differs from the 1-thread result by up to 1e-4 relative and the gradient by up to 7e-3 relative, and it changes from call to call. That is far above float64 reordering noise, and it makes scipy L-BFGS-B stop early in sklearnex multinomial LogisticRegression. The binary logistic_loss is not affected. Find and fix the root cause in the library so that threaded results are deterministic and equal to the 1-thread result. `bazel` is on PATH; this machine has no GPU. Do not weaken or delete existing tests.
